dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, Emma. How do you feel today?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈɛmə. ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈfiːl təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not well. I have the flu.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈwɛl. aɪ ˈhæv ðə ˈfluː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! Are you in a lot of pain?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ər juː ɪn ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈpeɪn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. My head and my back hurt.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. maɪ ˈhɛd ənd maɪ ˈbæk ˈhɜːrt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, and it's very good. I'm getting better.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd ɪts ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. aɪm ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈbɛtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks, Nam. You're a good friend.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm. jʊr ə ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛnd.
